# Time2Read

> Personalized, interactive reading adventures for children aged 3–15, with AI-generated illustrations, phonetic learning, and text-to-speech narration.

Time2Read creates never-ending, age-appropriate stories tailored to each child's reading level (PreK–10th grade). The first 3 stories are free; Premium starts with a 7-day free trial, then $9.99/month or $79/year. Every story has a 20-minute reading timer. Premium subscribers get unlimited live story generation, a saved story library, voice narration, and parent analytics.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Create a personalized reading adventure.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Premium, and Enterprise plans.
- [Sign in](/auth): Account login and signup.

## Guides

- [Free printable 20-minute reading log](/20-minute-reading-log): A weekly reading log to print, plus the 20-minute reading timer built into every story.
- [My child hates reading: what actually helps](/my-child-hates-reading): Research-based steps for reluctant readers, with sources.
- [Stories where your child is the main character](/stories-where-your-child-is-the-main-character): How personalized stories work, ages 3 to 15.
- [Is reading 20 minutes a day enough?](/is-reading-20-minutes-a-day-enough): Where the 20-minute rule and the 1.8 million words figure come from, and daily reading time by age.
- [Reading app with a timer for kids](/reading-app-with-timer-for-kids): The 20-minute reading timer built into every personalized story.
- [Reading app for kids struggling to read](/reading-app-for-kids-struggling-to-read): What to look for in an app for a struggling reader, and when to ask the school for help.
- [High-interest, low-level (hi-lo) stories](/high-interest-low-level-stories): Age-appropriate topics at an easier reading level, about exactly what your child loves.
- [Bedtime stories about your child's favorite things](/bedtime-stories-about-your-childs-favorite-things): Dinosaurs, unicorns, trucks or football: a new illustrated bedtime story starring your child.
- [Sight word story generator](/sight-word-story-generator): Beginner stories built on Dolch sight words, with your child as the main character.
- [How to make reading fun for a child with ADHD](/reading-for-kids-with-adhd): Supportive, practical ideas from ADHD and literacy specialists. Not medical advice.
- [Reading app for ESL kids](/reading-app-for-esl-kids): Easy English stories with pictures and tap-to-hear words for children learning English.
